critical_changes: C1 (Sec. 5.3, p. 11): correct 'the embedding errors change by at most 0.037 and keep their order'. Table 5 shows changes up to 0.064 (CLIP Sunburst 1.136->1.200; CLIP GPT Image 1 0.847->0.904) and two order swaps (CLIP Flare/FLUX.2 Max; CSD GPT Image 1/GPT Image 2). The 0.037 is computed against an unreported 11-scene pooled-target D, and the guard checks only the argmin. Report that baseline in Table 5 and restate as 'lowest-error configuration unchanged', or quote the change relative to the printed values; align the Introduction's 'change none of these orderings' accordingly.
minor_changes: M1: Shorten and simplify the abstract (~310 words). Define 'agreement'. Rephrase 'resolved as closer to the reference differences than making no distinctions' and 'close to what a faithful imitator would show' (say 'a share close to').

M2: Restructure Sec. 5.3 into labelled paragraphs (direction/size in features; representation dependence; genuine-painting calibration; aggregation/rescaling), each with a one-sentence takeaway. Move the Bonferroni-over-six and rho side analyses to App. A.
M3: State in one place which interval type each table uses (simultaneous Student, nominal Student, percentile bootstrap, reference bootstrap, joint), or harmonize Tables 4 and 5.

M4: In Sec. 5.2 report both cross-configuration correlations (the CLIP 0.96 appears only in the intro) and both variance ratios (CSD ~6 not stated; '11 times' gives ~9.8 from rounded Table 3), with scene-resampling intervals; note n = 6.

M5: Qualify 'aligned but oversized' as 'in reference units', or add a scale-calibrated Q, since the paper notes the excess may reflect a scale difference between clean generated images and photographed paintings.

M6: Fix unclear sentences: 'which does not depend on the name either' (p. 1); 'errors resolved below that level' (p. 2); the three stacked caveats in Sec. 3 Measurements (p. 4); 'so it serves as a reference point' (p. 6); 'sampled this way' (p. 7); 'the configuration with the largest CSD gain is best in at most 33.6%' (tie at 0.217, p. 12). Replace the repeated '(computed before rounding)' with one global note.
M7: Explain how reference works labelled 'route' enter the water/built/land content-matched targets.
M8: Mention in Sec. 5.3 that Sunburst's Monet-Sisley amplitude in the features is resolved negative (Table 17: -0.249 [-0.369, -0.140]).
M9: Main content runs to p. 13 (Broader Impact Statement to p. 14). Declare a long submission on OpenReview or trim ~1 page (SD-Turbo sentences, 'Other checks', rho discussion to appendix).
M10: Add downsampled contact sheets of all generated images, or an anonymized link, to the supplement (TMLR allows 100 MB); readers currently see one scene.
M11 (optional): Add a generic-name control (fictitious name, distant painters or an 'Impressionist' clause) and a time-separated third repeat for a subset to probe repeat dependence.
M12 (optional): Human spot-check of a random sample of the AI-only reference audits (230/870 label disagreements; 131 crops).
M13: Tighten appendix float placement (large blank areas on pp. 23, 25, 26, 28).
M14: Make the bibliography consistent (initials vs full names; inconsistent URL/DOI inclusion; Casper et al. venue).
M15: Supplement housekeeping: figures/PROVENANCE.json calls example_selection.json the manifest 'for Figure 1', but the image panel is Figure 2.
M16: De-emphasize the 25% exchangeable null ('far above the 25%', p. 7) in favor of the two benchmarks.
factual_errors: Sec. 5.3, p. 11: 'the embedding errors change by at most 0.037 and keep their order' is inconsistent with Table 5. Changes against the printed 14-scene D reach 0.064, and the full order is not preserved (CLIP Flare 1.057->1.074 vs FLUX.2 Max 1.058->1.023; CSD GPT Image 1 0.735->0.767 vs GPT Image 2 0.741->0.759). Only the lowest-error configuration is unchanged.
